note: Two separate levels of closure. Gate 0 scope-lock completion is about whether the scope is fully described, owned and honestly unresolved. Release acceptance additionally needs authorized decisions, repairs, runtime proof and credentialed acceptance. A Gate 0 verdict is never a release authorization.
separation: A Gate 0 verdict is never a release authorization.

level1.name: GATE_0_SCOPE_LOCK_COMPLETION

criteria.label: An exhaustive canonical route-method inventory.
criteria.requirement: Every route-method operation of the canonical universe has exactly one classification.
evidence: 1646 route-method operations, each in exactly one of six classes, 0 awaiting classification.

criteria.label: Engineering ownership or an explicit non-authorizing exception for every operation.
criteria.requirement: Every operation is OWNED, retired, stubbed, system or a decision-bound scope exception, and no exception is counted as owned.
evidence: 1505 owned, 97 retired, 31 stubbed, 9 system and 4 non-authorizing decision-bound scope exceptions.

criteria.label: Traceable persona specifications and product decisions.
criteria.requirement: Each persona has a ratified canonical, or its proposed baseline is carried as a blocker with its product decisions.
evidence: 3 unresolved personas each carry a proposed baseline, a decision package and a versioned decision record.

criteria.label: Preserved historical source uncertainty.
criteria.requirement: Unrecovered canonicals, grouped-only identifiers and conflicted identifiers keep their evidence status.
evidence: The 182 historical identifiers, the unrecovered canonicals and the 0B and 0C tranche records keep their evidence status and their hashes.

criteria.label: Complete downstream defect and obligation ownership.
criteria.requirement: Every defect, release-blocking item and tracked ratchet or test defect has an engineering owner, a target gate, a source reference and an acceptance condition.
evidence: 150 unique release-debt items each carry an engineering owner, a target gate, a source reference and an acceptance condition.
remainingItems: The 71 proposed dispositions are not accepted; ownership does not depend on their acceptance.

criteria.label: Explicit unresolved institutional decisions.
criteria.requirement: Every outstanding decision is listed with its state and no decision is adopted by implication.
evidence: 138 decision records are listed with their state; 0 are adopted.

criteria.label: No fabricated acceptance.
criteria.requirement: No persona baseline, disposition, challenge, decision or capability status is represented as accepted without independent approval evidence.
evidence: No persona, disposition, challenge, decision or carbon option is recorded as accepted or selected.

certificationBlockers.description: steward has no ratified canonical. The product owner decides the proposed package; this gate does not.
representative has no ratified canonical. The product owner decides the proposed package; this gate does not.
financial-officer has no ratified canonical. The product owner decides the proposed package; this gate does not.
4 carbon operations stay decision-bound exceptions until UE-INST-CARBON-ACCOUNTING-SCOPE is decided by the deciding authority.
The Gate 0C.3 registers are not accepted until an independent adversarial review accepts them.

level1.note: The criteria describe what the record must show. The blockers are the unfinished Gate 0 scope that the completion matrix carries. Both must clear before a Gate 0 certification is proposed.

criteria.label: Authorized security and business decisions.
criteria.requirement: The institutional decisions that the released capabilities depend on are adopted by an authority.

criteria.label: Corrective implementation.
criteria.requirement: The release-blocking repairs are made in source.
criteria.evidence: 150 repair obligations are open; none is repaired.

criteria.label: Runtime tenant-isolation proof.
criteria.requirement: Executed row-level-security and cross-organization negative proofs exist for the released operations.
criteria.evidence: 0 executed isolation proofs are on file; 2 challenged dispositions have no containment proof.

criteria.label: Native database and migration qualification.
criteria.requirement: The migrations and database roles are qualified on native PostgreSQL.
criteria.evidence: Native verification is false; 94 of 111 capabilities are pending.

criteria.label: Credentialed browser acceptance.
criteria.requirement: The persona journeys are accepted in a credentialed browser run.
criteria.evidence: Browser verification is false; 76 capabilities are pending.

criteria.label: Relevant regression and governance controls.
criteria.requirement: The regression suites and governance checks that cover the repairs pass.
criteria.evidence: The focused governance suites run and are not release regression evidence.

criteria.label: Closure or authorized disposition of release-blocking debt.
criteria.requirement: Every release-blocking item is repaired and proven, or carries an authorized release decision.
criteria.evidence: 34 release-blocking register defects, 0 closed obligations and 0 accepted release decisions.
